# muxt check reports, in html/template templates, comments and markup
# html/template writes otherwise than a browser reads them: a <!-- in
# <title> or <textarea>, a <! that starts no comment or doctype, a <?, a
# comment a browser ends at <!--> or --!> where html/template strips
# through the next -->, and a comment in <xmp>, which browsers show.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
template.gohtml:4:18: html/template writes this <!-- as text inside <title>; browsers show it
template.gohtml:8:4: html/template escapes this "<!", so browsers show it as text; comment with {{/* */}} or <!-- -->
template.gohtml:9:4: html/template escapes this "<?", so browsers show it as text; comment with {{/* */}} or <!-- -->
template.gohtml:10:4: browsers end this comment at the "<!-->" at 10:4 but html/template strips through the "-->" at 12:1, hiding the markup between
template.gohtml:14:23: html/template writes this <!-- as text inside <textarea>; browsers show it
template.gohtml:15:4: browsers end this comment at the "--!>" at 15:11 but html/template strips through the "-->" at 15:39, hiding the markup between
template.gohtml:16:6: html/template strips this comment, but browsers read <xmp> content as raw text and keep it

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><title>Todo<!-- draft --></title></head>
<body>
<!-- {{.}} is stripped, but it still runs -->
<p title="<!-- kept -->">kept</p>
<p><![if !IE]>shown</p>
<p><?php echo 1 ?></p>
<p><!-->hidden
<b>by html/template</b>
-->
<script>/* <!-- passes --> */</script>
<textarea name="note"><!-- shown --></textarea>
<p><!-- a --!><b>shown by browsers</b>--></p>
<xmp><!-- shown --></xmp>
</body>
</html>
{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var formHTML embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(formHTML, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Index() string {
	return "index"
}
